text:
emily: quick heads-up — halcyon-int8 canary is showing higher funcall validation rejections even though raw JSON parses. Looks like quoting/escape noise around backticks and slashes in tool args. :mag:

jon: can you paste an example?

emily: example (trimmed):
```{
  "tool":"exec",
  "args":{
    "cmd":"grep -R "`TODO`" /app/src || true"
  }
}
```
Note: the inner backticks are getting escaped inconsistently and sometimes emitted as a mismatched grave-accent char, causing schema linter to reject.

ravi: that's weird. Is this quant vocab packing again or CT-run EOS truncation?

emily: FP16 mirror ok (~0.1% reject), halcyon-int8 ~1.9% on 2.5k samples. Repro command I used: ```for i in $(seq 1 2500); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"halcyon-int8","prompt":"<funcall-bash-backtick>","max_tokens":300}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"; done | jq -r '.out' | grep -E 'reject|invalid' -c``` 

sasha: Try disabling continuous batching and streaming to see if it's boundary-related. Also run token-id diff for the prompt set between halcyon fp16 vs int8 vocabs.

ci-bot: Canary halcyon-int8 rolled to 30% at 3965432000 — https://deploys.redwood/3965432000

emily: re-ran with no-CB mirror and rejects dropped to 0.22% on 2k replay. Adding a proxy soft-coerce that normalizes grave/backtick variants reduces customer-facing rejects to 0.05%.

jon: sounds like CB+tokenization packing interaction. mitigation plan:
1) scale halcyon-int8 down to 5% immediately
2) enable fp16 mirror and no-CB mirror
3) add a tokenization-boundary simulator to onboard checks to catch backtick/escape spans across tokens
4) run quant-bisect toggling packing and bias-folding flags

ravi: I'll take the quant-bisect. sasha, can you add the onboard test and a small kvcache-boundary harness? also check kernel-level microflusher for int8 path.

sasha: will do. also suggest adding a linting proxy rule that auto-normalizes typical backtick variants for canaries until we fix the model path.

deploy-bot: Canary halcyon-int8 scaled to 5% at 3965432240 (actioned by @sasha)

emily: update (20m): no-CB + mirror reduced rejects to 0.18% on 2k; proxy-coerce reduces to 0.04%. filing incident doc with sample traces and token-id diffs. thanks all ❤️
